title: Native runtime CLI providers
description: Which runtime CLI produced a native trace: binary name, runtime implementation, the executionBackend values it writes, and whose execution the trace is (productRole doe: a Doe runtime, its traces are Doe execution; productRole dawn: a CLI driving Dawn through plain webgpu.h, its traces are Dawn execution and never Doe). Each executionBackend belongs to exactly one provider, so a comparison names the runtime behind every trace. backendSelection is backend-runtime-policy when the CLI selects its backend through config/backend-runtime-policy.json lanes (its trace meta carries selectionPolicyHash) and fixed when the CLI has a single backend and no lane policy.

productId.description: The bench run product id of this provider; Doe-role products take the workload contract's Doe (baseline) parameters and Dawn-role products its Dawn (comparison) parameters.
